description: This file defines an interface for processing loan accruals within the Fineract project, including methods for adding, reprocessing, and processing loan accruals and related financial transactions.

classes.name: LoanAccrualsProcessingService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for processing and managing loan accruals and associated transactions.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccruals
methods.description: Adds periodic accruals up to a specified date, optionally for a specific loan.

methods.name: addAccruals
methods.description: Adds accruals up to a specified date.

methods.name: reprocessExistingAccruals
methods.description: Reprocesses accruals for a specific loan, with an option to add an event.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Processes accruals when interest recalculation occurs, with options for enabling recalculation and adding journal entries.

methods.name: addIncomePostingAndAccruals
methods.description: Adds income posting and accruals for a specific loan identified by ID.

methods.name: processIncomePostingAndAccruals
methods.description: Processes income posting and accruals for a given loan, with an option to add an event.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnLoanClosure
methods.description: Processes accruals upon loan closure, with an option to add journal entries.

methods.name: processAccrualsOnLoanForeClosure
methods.description: Processes accruals upon loan foreclosure, given the foreclosure date and new accrual transactions.
